_comment: Illustrative map from validation kit check IDs to NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 controls, for oscal_export.py. A first draft to review, not a determination: the agency decides which controls a check evidences. A check not listed under 'checks' takes its track's controls. Control IDs are written as in the SP 800-53 text; the converter lowercases them for OSCAL.
